item.description: The ClockDomain class is missing a __hash__ method, causing TypeError when trying to use ClockDomain objects as dictionary keys or in sets. The class also lacked the reset_less attribute initialization in its constructor, causing AttributeError when accessing this attribute.

contract.description: Add a __hash__ method to the ClockDomain class that generates a consistent hash based on the domain properties. Ensure reset_less attribute is properly initialized in the ClockDomain constructor.

behavior.description: The ClockDomain class should implement a __hash__ method that returns a consistent hash value based on the domain's name, clk_edge, async_reset, reset_less, and local properties. The reset_less attribute should be accessible as self.reset_less.

output.description: An integer hash value representing the ClockDomain instance

acceptance.description: Tests that previously failed with "TypeError: unhashable type: 'ClockDomain'" and "AttributeError: 'ClockDomain' object has no attribute 'reset_less'" should now pass. Specifically test cases: tests/test_hdl_ir.py::DomainLookupTestCase::test_domain_lookup, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_propagate_create_missing, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_propagate_create_missing_fragment, tests/test_hdl_ir.py::FragmentDomainsTestCase::test_propagate_create_missing_fragment_many_domains, and various tests in test_sim.py that involve ClockDomain objects.

item.description: Simulator-related tests are failing with AttributeError when trying to access methods on None objects, suggesting simulator initialization or lifecycle management issues.

contract.description: Ensure simulator objects are properly initialized before attempting to access their methods. Fix null reference issues in simulator lifecycle management.

behavior.description: Simulator objects should be properly instantiated and initialized before any method calls on them. The simulator should correctly manage its internal state and not allow calls to methods on None objects.

exception.description: AttributeError when calling methods on None objects should not occur

acceptance.description: Tests that previously failed with "AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'tick'" and similar errors should now pass. Specifically test cases: tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_sample, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_edge, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_trigger_wrong, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_broken_multiedge, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_latch, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_delay, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_timeout, tests/test_sim.py::SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_valuecastable.
